mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic demand, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods following two consecutive quarters of GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which is associated with increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between sharp UNRATE decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month indicates a surge in supply-side activity, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening economy, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% in 1 month AND UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of HOUST and UNRATE changes on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over two consecutive months signals strong labor market conditions, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods following two consecutive months of strong PAYEMS growth, or the correlation between PAYEMS growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate coupled with an increase in consumer price index signals a potential inflationary environment, which is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.1% in 1 month AND CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of FEDFUNDS decrease and CPIAUCSL increase on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real retail and food services sales indicates strong consumer spending, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between RSAFS increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
